content: Israelwa sumanaibu God nuawadawada bedewe itui

content.text: Neba pokana etedina ita do bolana ene winene nowa dauwo wainedine leidina insedine,
poka sigasigauaida etedina.
Ne pokana sa insadewasamodine,
nuana enidasade.
Tane insaisa dea os ne insedine,
nuana sausadia ipa:
Iawe God nuawadawadawa ipa winakasalala,
sa baiwa me nuaparewa eueuwa no mainimbo ideita dewasade, mai eipona.
Tadinaida uduudu me ideita saua wadeditue,
no mainmbo euda os dewasade.
Ne neba wane wanase, “Iawe God,
e dea os ipa ne nebaanaida, mai dima da,
sa baiwa ne e sumanaiaidantepina.”
Apana mida sumanaibu Iawe God bedewe ituie me baiwaidantoia,
me euda mampo dewasade.
Sa baiwa euda ipa no nuamba aiaisiwa mampe me inanepia baiwa onioniawantonte wainenta,
ipawa me ando no saunepie inanepi.
Euda ipa no apana sanaa wainitana mampe,
God aiawa ruawantonta dewawa atentata.
Walama ipa God sai no osombo itumpo,
no ideita daina wainenta.
No me wawa bumpe dunentate nainimba dogo osowe itute
onioniantonta naita me ando no saunepi.
Naita apana no epanempa ba wakadisanempa,
no mai leusate onau enata, dia.
Ipawa Iawe God me mai apanawa dabuamoipe eidamoipona, dia.
Walama isiwa me poka edio no mainimbo wisede,
tane do me nuaparembaleidie saunede.
Ipawa me nuawadawadawa debama no bainimba winakasala winede.
Ulaipa walama isiwa poka ita nuapare edio apana mampo wisede,
tane me dewa sa dewasadia baiwa mai nuaeuwaleipona, dia.
